findings: takisui-sections.txt:4-5 精選版 日本国語大辞典 たきすい【滝水】: 江戸神田和泉町の酒屋、四方(よも)久兵衛で売っていた銘酒。滝の水。 Example from 談義本・根無草 (1763-69).

takisui-sections.txt:8-9 ろう‐すい【滝水】: 滝の水。滝。 is a different reading.
Frozen 滝-nikkoku.txt (teaching-reconciliation-002 source-sections) 滝 [2]: 「たきすい（滝水）」の略, with the 洒落本・仕懸文庫 (1791) example 「たきがあらばちっとわってくんねへ」.
coordinatorSourceCheck.conclusion: 日本国語大辞典 explicitly makes 滝 [2] an abbreviation of the reading たきすい, whose only 日国 sense is an Edo brand of sake. The waterfall-water senses belong to たきみず and ろうすい, not to the abbreviated word. The learner-facing gloss 'water from a waterfall' for the abbreviation is therefore contradicted, not merely unsupported.
